section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种用于人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，包括基盘和数据采集设备，所述基盘顶部的中心处开设有组接槽，且组接槽的内部滑动安装有移位滚珠，所述移位滚珠的顶部固定连接有支架，且数据采集设备设于支架的顶部，所述组接槽的两侧壁均开设有横向滑轨。该用于人工智能机器学习的数据采集装置，可向外翻转横翻座和纵翻座，使得横翻座和纵翻座翻转一百八十度至水平状态，此时横向延伸轨道朝上并与横向滑轨连通，纵向延伸轨道朝上并与竖向滑轨连通，从而使得移位滚珠的移动范围增加了一倍，此时可通过移动支架带动移位滚珠在横向滑轨、横向延伸轨道、竖向滑轨和纵向延伸轨道内移动，从而使得数据采集设备的拍摄方向具有多向性。

The utility model discloses a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, including basal disc and data acquisition equipment, the center department at basal disc top has seted up the group and has connect the groove, and the inside slidable mounting in group groove has the aversion ball, the top fixedly connected with support of aversion ball, and data acquisition equipment locate the top of support, horizontal slide rail has all been seted up to the both sides wall in group groove. This a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, can outwards overturn violently turn over the seat and indulge the seat of turning over, make violently turn over one hundred eighty degrees to the horizontality with indulging the seat upset, horizontal extension track is up and with horizontal slide rail intercommunication this moment, vertical extension track is up and with vertical slide rail intercommunication, thereby make the displacement ball's migration range increase one time, accessible movable support drives the displacement ball at horizontal slide rail this moment, horizontal extension track, vertical slide rail and vertical extension intra-orbit remove, thereby make the shooting direction of data acquisition equipment have the multi-directionality.

Data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learningTechnical Field

The utility model relates to an artificial intelligence data acquisition device technical field specifically is a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning.

Background

The term artificial intelligence was originally proposed at the Dartmouth society of 1956, since then researchers developed many theories and principles, and the concept of artificial intelligence was also expanded, artificial intelligence, abbreviated as AI in english, is a branch of computer science, which attempts to understand the essence of intelligence and produce a new intelligent machine that can respond in a manner similar to human intelligence, including robots, language recognition, image recognition, natural language processing, expert systems, etc., and since birth, artificial intelligence has become increasingly sophisticated in theory and technology, and its application field is expanding, and it is assumed that the scientific and technological products brought by artificial intelligence in the future will be containers for human beings.

The existing artificial intelligence machine collects data through a worker, and then transmits the data to a logic operation mechanism in the artificial intelligence machine for analysis, so that the learning effect is achieved.

In fact, need carry the data acquisition device to the open air more, carry out sound and image acquisition in the open air, can make artificial intelligence press close to actual operation environment more, data acquisition equipment settles on the bottom plate more, is provided with the gyro wheel seat below the bottom plate, conveniently promotes the overall device and removes each position and gather, and the weak point that exists is: when the images around the data acquisition equipment need to be acquired, the integral device needs to be pushed, so that the roller seat rolls on the ground, and the shooting direction of the camera of the data acquisition equipment is continuously changed, thereby being inconvenient.

Therefore, it is necessary to design a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning so as to solve the problems set forth above.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning to solve the problem that above-mentioned background art provided.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, includes basal disc and data acquisition equipment, the center department at basal disc top has seted up the group and has connect the groove, and the inside slidable mounting in group groove has the aversion ball, the top fixedly connected with support of aversion ball, and data acquisition equipment locates the top of support, horizontal slide rail has all been seted up to the both sides wall in group groove, and the inside of horizontal slide rail has violently to turn over the seat through locating pin axle movable mounting, violently turn over the bottom of seat and set up the horizontal extension track with aversion ball looks adaptation, vertical slide rail has all been seted up to the preceding inner wall in group groove and back inner wall, and the inside of vertical slide rail has indulged through locating pin movable mounting and turns over the seat, indulge the bottom of turning over the seat and set up the vertical extension track with aversion ball looks adaptation, auto-lock universal gyro wheel is installed at the top of basal disc.

Preferably, four side surfaces of the base plate are fixedly connected with limit baffles, and the directional pin shaft is rotatably arranged on the limit baffles.

Preferably, the number of the self-locking universal rollers is four, and the four self-locking universal rollers are respectively positioned at four corners of the bottom of the base plate.

Preferably, the top of the base plate is fixedly connected with two pushers which are set in parallel, and the surfaces of the pushers are provided with sheaths.

Preferably, the top of the base plate is fixedly connected with four foot plates, and the four foot plates are distributed in a rectangular shape.

Preferably, the support includes the expansion bracket, and the thread groove has been seted up at the top of support, the surface of expansion bracket bottom is equipped with screw thread I, and the bottom threaded connection of expansion bracket is in the thread groove.

Preferably, the surface of the support is fixedly connected with a rotating disc, and the surface of the rotating disc is provided with a hand groove.

Preferably, the top of the data acquisition equipment is fixedly connected with an arc-shaped shield, an arc edge of the arc-shaped shield is vertically upward, and the top of the arc-shaped shield is provided with an overflow groove.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

(1) this a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, the user can hold the pushing hands and promote data collection equipment, auto-lock universal gyro wheel is in the roll state this moment, thereby make things convenient for data collection equipment's removal, make it use better flexibility in the open air, when using needs fixed data collection equipment, adjustable auto-lock universal gyro wheel to lock-out state, thereby make data collection equipment can stably put, its auto-lock universal gyro wheel is current product, its structure is not too much repeated, data collection equipment's suitability has been strengthened.

(2) The data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning is characterized in that when the data acquisition device is used, the shifting ball can freely slide in the assembling groove, so that a user can freely adjust the required direction to shoot, the transversely-turning seat and the longitudinally-turning seat can be turned outwards to turn the transversely-turning seat and the longitudinally-turning seat one hundred eighty degrees to a horizontal state, the transversely-extending track at the bottom of the transversely-turning seat faces upwards and is communicated with the transverse slide rail, the longitudinally-extending track at the bottom of the longitudinally-turning seat faces upwards and is communicated with the vertical slide rail, and the transverse slide rail and the vertical slide rail are in a smooth state, so that the moving range of the shifting ball is doubled, and the shifting ball can be driven by the moving bracket to move in the transverse slide rail, the transversely-extending track, the vertical slide rail and the longitudinally-extending track, so that the shooting direction of the data acquisition device has multi-directionality, and the shooting limitation caused by poor outdoor road conditions or poor position selection is avoided, the practicability is improved.

(3) This a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning, horizontal extension track and longitudinal extension track can be accomodate in horizontal slide rail and vertical slide rail, it is little to make its area occupied when not using, increase the portability, and the expansion bracket can rotate at the support top, rotate the height of in-process alright adjustable data acquisition equipment, so that the user of different heights uses, and make the height of shooting also different, hand slot person of facilitating the use puts into the operation support with the finger on the capstan, and reasonable in design, the operation is laborsaving, the arc at data acquisition equipment top is sheltered from and can be protected it, avoid the unexpected impaired of data acquisition equipment.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a technical solution: a data acquisition device for artificial intelligence machine learning comprises a base plate 1 and data acquisition equipment 5, wherein the center of the top of the base plate 1 is provided with a connecting groove 2, and the inside of the assembly groove 2 is slidably provided with a shifting ball 3, the top of the shifting ball 3 is fixedly connected with a bracket 4, and the data acquisition equipment 5 is arranged at the top of the bracket 4, the two side walls of the assembly groove 2 are both provided with transverse sliding rails 6, a transverse overturning seat 8 is movably arranged in the transverse sliding rail 6 through a positioning pin shaft 7, the bottom of the transverse overturning seat 8 is provided with a transverse extending rail 80 matched with the shifting ball 3, the front inner wall and the rear inner wall of the assembling groove 2 are both provided with vertical sliding rails 9, and the inside of the vertical slide rail 9 is movably provided with a longitudinal overturning seat 10 through a positioning pin, the bottom of the longitudinal overturning seat 10 is provided with a longitudinal extending rail 100 matched with the shifting ball 3, and the top of the base plate 1 is provided with a self-locking universal roller 12.

Four sides of the base plate 1 are fixedly connected with limit baffles 11, and the directional pin shaft is rotatably installed on the limit baffles 11.

The number of the self-locking universal rollers 12 is four, and the four self-locking universal rollers 12 are respectively positioned at four corners of the bottom of the base plate 1.

The top of the base plate 1 is fixedly connected with two push handles 13 which are set in parallel, and the surfaces of the push handles 13 are provided with sheaths.

The top of the base plate 1 is fixedly connected with four foot pedals 14, and the four foot pedals 14 are distributed in a rectangular shape.

The support 4 comprises an expansion bracket 15, a thread groove 40 is formed in the top of the support 4, a thread I150 is arranged on the surface of the bottom end of the expansion bracket 15, and the bottom end of the expansion bracket 15 is connected in the thread groove 40 in a threaded mode.

The surface of the bracket 4 is fixedly connected with a rotary disk 16, and the surface of the rotary disk 16 is provided with a hand groove 17.

The arc that the top fixedly connected with arc of data acquisition equipment 5 sheltered from 18, and the arc limit that the arc sheltered from 18 is vertical upwards, and the overflow launder has been seted up at the top that the arc sheltered from 18.

The working principle is as follows: a user can hold the push handle 13 to push the data acquisition equipment 5, and the self-locking universal roller 12 is in a rolling state at the moment, so that the data acquisition equipment 5 can be conveniently moved and can be used more flexibly outdoors, when the data acquisition equipment 5 needs to be fixed in use, the self-locking universal roller 12 can be adjusted to be in a locking state, so that the data acquisition equipment 5 can be stably placed, the self-locking universal roller 12 is an existing product, the structure is not repeated too much, and the applicability of the data acquisition equipment 5 is enhanced; when the device is used, the shifting ball 3 can freely slide in the assembling groove 2, so that a user can freely adjust the required direction to shoot, the transverse overturning seat 8 and the longitudinal overturning seat 10 can be outwards overturned, the transverse overturning seat 8 and the longitudinal overturning seat 10 are overturned for one hundred eighty degrees to be in a horizontal state, the transverse extending rail 80 at the bottom of the transverse overturning seat 8 faces upwards and is communicated with the transverse sliding rail 6, the longitudinal extending rail 100 at the bottom of the longitudinal overturning seat 10 faces upwards and is communicated with the vertical sliding rail 9, the transverse sliding rail 6 and the vertical sliding rail 9 are in a smooth state, so that the moving range of the shifting ball 3 is doubled, at the moment, the shifting ball 3 can be driven by the moving bracket 4 to move in the transverse sliding rail 6, the transverse extending rail 80, the vertical sliding rail 9 and the longitudinal extending rail 100, so that the shooting direction of the data acquisition equipment 5 has multi-directionality, and the shooting limitation caused by poor outdoor road conditions or poor position selection is avoided, the practicability is improved; horizontal extension track 80 and longitudinal extension track 100 can be accomodate in horizontal slide rail 3 and vertical slide rail 9, make its area occupied when not using little, increase the portability, and expansion bracket 15 can rotate at support 4 top, just can adjust data acquisition equipment 5's height at the rotation in-process, so that the user of different heights uses, and make the height of shooting also different, the last hand slot 17 person of facilitating the use of will pointing of carousel 16 puts into and operates support 4, and reasonable design, and the operation is laborsaving, the arc at data acquisition equipment 5 top shelters from 18 and can protect it, avoid data acquisition equipment 5 unexpected impaired.

Those not described in detail in this specification are within the skill of the art.

Although the present invention has been described in detail with reference to the foregoing embodiments, it will be apparent to those skilled in the art that modifications may be made to the embodiments or portions thereof without departing from the spirit and scope of the invention.
